problem: XiaoYu one-click readiness and detached plugin reconcile still assumed N.E.K.O default ports 48911/48912/48915/48916. N.E.K.O can negotiate fallback public/internal ports, so a healthy runtime can be misclassified as failed or plugin recovery can poll an obsolete generation.

authority.readiness_and_ports: N.E.K.O launcher.json state=ready plus negotiated ports/internal_ports
authority.xiaoyu_role: read-only consumer plus bounded health verification

selected.mechanism: consume native launcher.json and dynamically bind XiaoYu observers to negotiated public/internal ports
selected.http_role: final health verification only; explicit URLs are compatibility fallback only when the native record is absent
selected.plugin_reconcile: re-read launcher.json on every retry so generation/port replacement cannot leave the adapter pinned to stale endpoints

acceptance: state=starting/invalid native records never cause guessed-default probing
state=ready record selects TOOL_SERVER_PORT and USER_PLUGIN_SERVER_PORT for plugin reconcile
one-click selects MAIN/MEMORY/TOOL and USER_PLUGIN ports from the same native record
one-click still verifies all core HTTP endpoints before declaring backend ready
custom StorageRoot is forwarded to the hidden native start path so the observer and owner share the same runtime record
no new process owner, lock, daemon, transport or credential authority is introduced
ordinary agent push continues through reuse, architecture, parse and product-worktree gates
retirement_condition: Remove the XiaoYu record adapter when the official N.E.K.O desktop/native launcher exposes a direct owner-ready/endpoint attachment seam to the Companion host and plugin reconcile no longer needs an external observer.
